name: Native FP32/FP16/BF16 frozen primitive refresh against the complete vendor pool
registration: Before the first measurement of this fresh cohort; historical configurations reused, no new tuning
preflight_failures: Preserve launch error; retry environmental preflight only when no timed case exists
contracts: Inputs and weights natively sampled in the requested dtype; FP32 accumulation/output. Original FP32 weights stay FP32. No lossy conversion, TF32 or reduced precision accumulation.
inputs: One seeded synthetic weight and activation tensor per shape; distinct original weight copies >=max(80MiB,20*L2), each copy bitwise identical. No checkpoint or captured-activation claim.
vendor_pool: Up to8 cuBLASLt heuristics for each original/transposed layout; FP32 compute and allowed reduction types only, shared64MiBworkspace; plain/packed strict cuBLAS GEMM, Torch mm, plus FP32 GEMV for M1. Each vendor has its own A/A twin; vendor algorithm discovery outside timing, all tested routes retained.
measurement: Captured streaming GPU work, >=31 randomized paired rounds, no eviction kernel. Graph replay excludes host dispatch/setup/allocator costs. No eager or full-model claim.
numerics: Unchanged FP64 oracle and original tolerances, all captured output elements checked, before/after timing, exact weight/input preservation and packed FP32 roundtrip. Invalid vendors and custom failures retained.
acceptance: Each case must pass all numerical/input/context checks and have one stable observed memory-clock regime, matching across all3processes in its cohort; abs(fastest eligible vendor own A/A)<=1%; paired95% latency-saved lower bound>10%, best eligible vendor reselected within each2000draw bootstrap. All3fresh processes required per dtype/shape/profile.
power: Normal system76-power profiles only, same AC condition, restore initial profile/brightness in finally. No clocks, voltage, power-limit or driver changes.
provenance: Report original profileSHA/choices, exact sources/PTX/bridge and cuBLAS/runtime binaries, actual GPU UUID/kernel/unlock flags, raw rounds, input bytesSHA, telemetry/context/setup/storage; never claim hardware-unlocked comparison without actual data.
unsupported_formats: SM86 has no native FP8/FP4 Tensor Core math. No lossy emulation in this exact-weight study; unsupported entries stay explicit.
